description: This file contains the implementation of classes and functions for handling the translation logic, configuration, request transformation, response parsing, and iteration for Anthropic's `/v1/complete` endpoint within the litellm project. It defines custom exceptions, configuration classes, and response iterators specific to Anthropic models like Claude.

classes.name: AnthropicTextError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors related to Anthropic API responses.

classes.name: AnthropicTextConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Anthropic API parameters, including methods for request transformation and response parsing.

classes.name: AnthropicTextCompletionResponseIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for parsing streaming responses from Anthropic's completion API.

methods.name: AnthropicTextError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the custom error with status code and message, and constructs HTTP request/response objects.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.__init__
methods.description: Initializes configuration parameters for Anthropic API calls, with defaults and optional overrides.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.validate_environment
methods.description: Prepares and validates headers for API call, ensuring API key is present.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.transform_request
methods.description: Creates the request payload for the Anthropic API based on messages and model.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns list of supported OpenAI-like parameters for Anthropic API.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Anthropic-specific parameters for API requests.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.transform_response
methods.description: Parses the raw API response, updates the model response object, and calculates token usage.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.get_error_class
methods.description: Returns appropriate exception class for API errors.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig._is_anthropic_text_model
methods.description: Checks if a model name corresponds to an Anthropic Claude model.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig._get_anthropic_text_prompt_from_messages
methods.description: Generates prompt string from messages, using custom prompts if registered.

methods.name: AnthropicTextConfig.get_model_response_iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for streaming responses.

methods.name: AnthropicTextCompletionResponseIterator.chunk_parser
methods.description: Parses a chunk of streaming response into a GenericStreamingChunk object.
